additions.provenance: server_only service_role_only assessment submit authority; server grades exact persisted assessment for the development-session-derived hotel and staff user; database rechecks active same-hotel staff user, same-hotel assignment identity, completed training, same-plan assessment lineage and exact hashes, then uses a per-hotel-staff-assessment advisory lock to assign attempt_no atomically and inserts an automatic verified result only when the graded attempt is already verified

server_only service_role_only human-review authority; server binds review to exact pending attempt and individual reviewer identity; database rechecks same hotel, active subject and reviewer, forbids self review, permits only department_manager or hotel_manager, enforces same department for department_manager, rejects an already verified attempt and binds sourceAttemptHash plus reviewer identity before immutable verified-result insert

server_only manager action target lookup derives hotel_id from the authenticated individual development identity and reads only one exact active target staff_user by hotel_id plus staff_user_id before department-scope authorization

server_only revision allocator reads only revision_no rows scoped by development-identity hotel_id plus validated standard_key; result is used to choose the next immutable standard revision and never discovers another hotel
server_only revision allocator reads only revision_no rows scoped by development-identity hotel_id plus validated assessment_key before immutable assessment publication
server_only hotel-manager-only HR rule revision allocator reads only revision_no rows scoped by the manager development identity hotel_id plus validated rule_set_key
server_only manager scope validation reads one exact training plan revision by development-identity hotel_id plus revision id before assignment or assessment authoring

server_only department-manager scope validation reads the exact same-hotel standard revision referenced by the selected training plan and verifies every departmentCode matches the manager operational department

server_only individual identity resolver reads one active staff_user by exact hotel_id and staff_user_id; hotel_id is derived from an already validated operational staff session or development session

server_only personal PIN provisioning occurs only after individual manager authority; target is an exact same-hotel staff_user and department_manager is restricted to the same department while hotel_manager may manage the hotel; stored value is a salted scrypt hash and composite tenant FKs prevent cross-hotel identity

server_only identity candidate list requires a valid current operational session and reads only active staff_users for that operational-session-derived hotel before filtering to the active manager or department runtime scope
server_only candidate list checks only whether eligible same-hotel staff_user ids have an active personal credential; pin hashes are not selected or returned

server_only identity authentication reads one active credential by operational-session-derived hotel_id plus exact selected staff_user_id only after role or department identity matching; secret PIN is verified with scrypt server-side

server_only service_role_only personal-PIN throttle RPC receives exact operational-session-derived hotel_id and matched staff_user_id, row-locks only that active credential and applies bounded failed-attempt and 15-minute lock state
server_only service_role_only PIN-throttle reset runs only after successful scrypt verification and resets only the exact active credential scoped by hotel_id plus staff_user_id
server_only successful identity login revokes any prior active development session for the exact operational-session-derived hotel_id plus operational_session_id before creating a replacement

server_only development session insert binds exact hotel_id, individual staff_user_id and current operational_session_id with composite same-hotel FKs plus a secret SHA256 session token and an expiry capped by the operational session

server_only development-session lookup first resolves the requested hotel slug and then requires both hotel_id and secret token hash; it additionally revalidates the referenced current operational session, active staff_user and role or department match before returning identity
server_only development logout resolves hotel slug then revokes only the session matching that hotel_id plus secret token hash; no cross-hotel token-only update remains
